title: Example 285 mutant-security: the bounded method label decided as stated, expected refuted
description: The frozen claim claims/bounded-method-label.json (key 196346d46d4d81fb) on the task's pinned closure, by jvmcontract's own checker under strict gaps, as the task states it: no wrapper and no narrower subject. Until this change the task was refused before any proof (input-construction:interface-parameter, VF-027), because WebMvcTags#method takes a javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest. jvmcontract now gives a parameter of an interface type an implementation of the accessors the target calls (here getMethod(), any String of up to 8 code units), reads the Tag result through getKey() and getValue() with Strings compared by content, and runs HttpMethod's map of names through a HashMap model. This run is the gap packet's closure test: the unchanged claim on the same artifacts. The constructed mutant (2.7.18 with controls/raw-method-fallback.patch, which falls back to the raw method) must fail the claim the fixed release satisfies; expected refuted with a witness run on a JVM.
expected: example 285 task mutant-security gives its expected conclusion, refuted: build.py prints 'as expected' and exits 0

resources.notes: the earlier attempts of this task took 122 s and 0.2 GB, of which 120 s was the gap scan running into its limit; the scan now takes 0.04 s and the proof 0.1 s in a debug build, so the time is the acquisition, the two JVM control runs and the release build of lib/ if its tree isn't cached
